<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def dots():
    nodes=current_frame.segmentation['nodes']; out=[]
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='N':
            pts=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
            ch=[nodes[c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
            out.append((min(rs),min(cs),n['pixels'],ch))
    return sorted(out)
print('start', dots())

print('after click id16', dots(), 'lvl=',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'done=',last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
